attempts.summary: Deployed a Python stdlib HTTP inventory application (SQLite-backed, GET/POST /items) on node1, running as a dedicated unprivileged systemd service bound to 0.0.0.0:8181, confined by a custom AppArmor profile (/etc/apparmor.d/opt.inventory-app.app.py) loaded and running in enforce mode. Verified the app is reachable and functional over $NODE_IP:8181 with AppArmor actively enforcing (not complain/disabled) and zero denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service, AppArmor enforcement, port binding, and inventory data all recovered post-restart.
